comparison_variable: full 83-rotation Frobenius canonicalization scan (reference) versus exact longest-zero-gap candidate scan (candidate); same binary, same 22-bit hashed bucket directory, same 18-byte records, same target
correctness: Each arm must reproduce every frozen ARM_FIELDS value of its mode's published raw row (stage_wrapper), including operation_counts (canonical_rotation_steps 328000000/656000000 full scan, 19127078/38261354 zero gap) and lookup_sample (canonical key and stored Frobenius shift for the 64 roots of the first 32 indexed states). Both arms must share the 20-field pair certificate, so canonical keys, shifts, first-witness samples, hit counts, outcomes and the native generator control agree.

decision_rule.invalid: Any noise or correctness gate fails, or fewer than 16 valid pairs: no verdict; every raw row is preserved; the 1.42x figure stays exploratory.
decision_rule.magnitude_check: Separately for a valid panel: 1.4232676 inside the primary interval -> exploratory_magnitude_consistent; interval upper bound < 1.4232676 -> exploratory_magnitude_refuted_overstated; lower bound > 1.4232676 -> exploratory_magnitude_refuted_understated.
decision_rule.not_promoted_inconclusive: Interval contains 1: no Tier 1 speedup; the exploratory 1.42x is not promoted.
decision_rule.promoted: Primary interval lower bound > 1: Tier 1 instance-scoped canonicalization-phase speedup, reported as the measured median and interval with provider, instance ID and tier (not as 1.42x).
decision_rule.refuted_regression: Primary interval upper bound < 1: the zero-gap scan is slower in this phase on this instance; the exploratory speedup is refuted at Tier 1.
decision_rule.scope: A promoted result is a stage diagnostic on one frozen target and one instance; it is not a complete single-target IC speedup, which still needs a verified complete solve and same-point rho.
decision_rule.secondary: The target-stage ratio gets the same promoted / refuted_regression / not_promoted_inconclusive classification and is reported beside the primary; it never changes the primary verdict.

host: fresh GitHub Actions ubuntu-24.04 standard runner, one job, one pinned exposed CPU (minimum of the observed affinity mask)
measurement_boundary: Native one-target bounded PDP clock (timing_ns.target_pdp_and_native_check) after target-independent setup, factor-base, root index and lookup sample; includes target query preparation, batched S3 roots, root conversion and Frobenius canonicalization, exact lookup and native relation checks. The canonicalization phase is timing_ns.target_cycle_canonical, a sub-interval of target_partner_check. Process launch, index build and wrapper verification are outside both intervals.
noise_gates: isolated_bench Tier 1 preflight ok before the panel and before and after every arm (Linux, execution CPU inside affinity, container cpu.stat nr_throttled and memory oom counters readable)
per arm: exit 0, no timeout, verified=1, executable digest unchanged, cpu.stat nr_throttled delta 0, memory_events oom and oom_kill delta 0
per arm: target_query_preparation + target_s3_batch + target_partner_check <= target_pdp_and_native_check, and target_cycle_canonical + target_exact_lookup <= target_partner_check
per pair: all eight pair_fields equal and equal to expected_fields
panel: 32 valid arms in the frozen order, one binary digest, artifacts unchanged across the panel
recorded_not_gated: steal ticks, IRQ and softirq deltas on the execution CPU
child involuntary context switches and major faults
child user and system CPU time

exploratory_reference.canonicalization_phase_ratio_source: ratio of six-run medians 2215795406 / 1556836845 ns in ../packed_index_e1_canonical_20261009/summary.json (unisolated macOS arm64, three adjacent pairs)

statistics.interval: paired bootstrap 95%: random.Random(20261011), 10000 resamples of the 16 per-pair ratios with replacement, median of each, sorted, [index 250, index 9749]; a fresh generator for each statistic

negative_control.name: s3_batch_phase_ratio
negative_control.per_pair: reference timing_ns.target_s3_batch / candidate timing_ns.target_s3_batch; identical work in both arms, reported to show instrument noise, never gated

primary.name: canonicalization_phase_ratio
primary.per_pair: reference timing_ns.target_cycle_canonical / candidate timing_ns.target_cycle_canonical, from the base64 raw native result in each arm's stdout

secondary.name: target_stage_ratio
secondary.per_pair: reference online_ms / candidate online_ms (timing_ns.target_pdp_and_native_check), the isolated_bench paired speedup

stop_rule: Run the panel once per workflow attempt. Never rerun to replace an invalid or unfavourable panel; a further attempt is a new receipt reported alongside the first.
